brief.en: A rested commuter has repeatedly accepted humming karaoke and recovered alertness after using it; confidence in both histories is high. They drive the long familiar night highway home after routine work. After monotony prevention fires, humming_karaoke should rank first and produce a complete five-track content plan.
brief.ja: 休養十分な通勤者は鼻歌カラオケを繰り返し受諾し、使用後に覚醒が回復しており、両履歴の信頼度も高い。 通常勤務後、長く慣れた夜間高速道路で帰宅する。 漫然予防発火後、humming_karaokeが首位となり、5曲の完全なコンテンツ計画を生成する。

expected_delta.en: Changing only humming recovery should move rank one from humming karaoke to playlist.
expected_delta.ja: 鼻歌回復率だけの変更で、首位が鼻歌カラオケからプレイリストへ移る。

rationale.en: The pair changes only profile.service_recovery_rate.humming_karaoke, isolating repeated recovery evidence from acceptance, recency, route, and seed. Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 11–15 and 41–61 (driving services and history-informed prioritization).
rationale.ja: 対ではprofile.service_recovery_rate.humming_karaokeだけを変え、受諾・直近性・ルート・seedから反復回復根拠を分離する。 CDC-SUスライド11–15および41–61（走行中サービスと履歴に基づく優先順位）に基づく。

narrative.en: They drive the long familiar night highway home after routine work. The early rest point passes and monotony accumulates on the featureless familiar highway.
narrative.ja: 通常勤務後、長く慣れた夜間高速道路で帰宅する。 早い休憩地点を通過し、特徴のない慣れた高速道路で単調さが蓄積する。

assumptions.en: Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 11–15 and 41–61 (driving services and history-informed prioritization).
assumptions.ja: CDC-SUスライド11–15および41–61（走行中サービスと履歴に基づく優先順位）に基づく。

assumptions.en: The resolved profile-semantic-s01-humming-recovers history is fixed before the trip and is not changed during replay.
assumptions.ja: 解決済みのprofile-semantic-s01-humming-recovers履歴は出発前に固定し、リプレイ中は変更しません。

constraints.en: The driver must remain attentive and cannot operate a screen while moving.
constraints.ja: 走行中は注意を維持し、画面操作はできない。

goals.en: Complete this necessary journey without compromising driving safety.
goals.ja: 必要な移動を、運転の安全を損なわずに終える。

name.ja: 鼻歌カラオケで回復する通勤者

narrative.en: Commuter helped by humming karaoke. A rested commuter has repeatedly accepted humming karaoke and recovered alertness after using it; confidence in both histories is high.

preferences.en: Humming karaoke is familiar, accepted, and repeatedly effective for this driver.
preferences.ja: 鼻歌カラオケはこの運転者にとって慣れており、受諾され、繰り返し有効だった。

purpose.en: After monotony prevention fires, humming_karaoke should rank first and produce a complete five-track content plan.

before_trip.en: A rested commuter has repeatedly accepted humming karaoke and recovered alertness after using it; confidence in both histories is high.

journey_evolution.en: The early rest point passes and monotony accumulates on the featureless familiar highway.
journey_evolution.ja: 早い休憩地点を通過し、特徴のない慣れた高速道路で単調さが蓄積する。

state_at_departure.en: Physical signals start at 5; humming recovery is 95%, music recovery 65%, and unsupported radio history is deliberately weak.

trip_reason.en: They drive the long familiar night highway home after routine work.
trip_reason.ja: 通常勤務後、長く慣れた夜間高速道路で帰宅する。

title.en: Prioritize humming karaoke that repeatedly restores this driver’s alertness
title.ja: 覚醒を繰り返し回復した鼻歌カラオケを優先する

what_to_watch.en: Whether the authored state and journey evidence remain visible in the explanation for TC-S01.
what_to_watch.ja: TC-S01の説明に、設定した状態と旅程の根拠が明示されるか。

what_to_watch.en: Whether downstream service and content behavior follows the declared expectation without hidden overrides.
